Operations Manager, Fulfillment Center
Parcelway
Location: Reno, NV (on-site)

Responsibilities:
- Manage daily fulfillment operations for a 300-person site.
- Improve throughput, accuracy and safety metrics.
- Lead shift supervisors and drive continuous improvement.
- Own labor planning and budget.

Requirements:
- 5+ years of operations management experience in warehousing or logistics.
- Experience with lean or Six Sigma methods.
- Experience managing budgets and labor planning.
- Must be able to work on-site and on weekends as needed.

Preferred qualifications:
- Six Sigma Green Belt certification.
- Experience with warehouse management systems.
